evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and updates Guix reproducible build configurations under contrib/guix and ci/lint/requirements.txt.
rationale: Fixes native Guix build failures on riscv64-linux by updating the Guix time-machine commit and package overrides. As reported in #36232, running Guix builds natively on riscv64-linux fails with 'package python-lief@0.17.5 does not support riscv64-linux'.
